title: Store and support hours
body: Chat support is open 24/7. Stores open 9am-8pm Monday to Saturday, 10am-6pm Sunday.

title: Paying your bill
body: Pay in the app, online, by autopay, or in a store. Bills are issued on the 1st and due on the 21st.

title: Autopay discount
body: Autopay with a bank account takes $5 off each line per month. Card autopay has no discount.

title: International roaming
body: Mobile Unlimited and Unlimited Plus include roaming in 30 countries. Essentials needs the $10/day travel pass.

title: Changing plans
body: Plan changes take effect on the next bill. Billing can change a plan and pro-rate the difference.

title: Outage credits
body: Customers affected by a confirmed outage of 4 hours or more get a credit once the outage is resolved. Tech support confirms the outage; billing applies the credit to the next bill.

title: Returning a device
body: Devices can be returned within 14 days in original condition. Device damage claims go to the device protection partner.

title: Router offline
body: If the router light is red: power-cycle it for 30 seconds, check the fiber cable is seated, then run line diagnostics. Persistent red after reset needs a technician.

title: Slow home internet
body: Run a wired speed test. Wi-Fi speeds below plan are usually interference; move the router or use 5 GHz. A throttled line shows 'speed-throttled' in diagnostics and is fixed by billing if it is a plan cap.

title: No mobile data (APN)
body: If calls work but data does not, the APN may be wrong. Set APN to 'nwmobile' in settings, then restart the phone.

title: SIM not provisioned
body: A new SIM that shows 'no service' may not be provisioned. Tech support can re-push provisioning; it takes up to 15 minutes.

title: eSIM transfer
body: Transfer an eSIM in phone settings with the QR code from the app. The old device loses service when the transfer completes.

title: Area outages
body: Check the outage feed by zip code before troubleshooting a device. During a confirmed outage, do not book a technician; service returns when the outage is fixed.

title: Booking a technician
body: Book a technician only when diagnostics show a fault at the customer's address and there is no area outage.

title: Disputing a charge
body: Billing reviews disputed charges on the open invoice. Paid invoices older than 60 days cannot be disputed.

title: How outage credits are calculated
body: Credit = whole days of outage (rounded up) x the line's daily rate (monthly price / days in month). Only the affected service's line. Capped at one month.
